in_hebrew.name: בנדיקטו
in_hebrew.meaning: ברוך הוא, אחד מקבל ברכה מאלוהים
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם בנדיקטו נגזר מהמילה הלטינית 'בנדיקтус', שפירושה 'ברוך'. הוא קשור למושג קבלת ברכה מאלוהים, ומשמש לעתים קרובות בהקשר של שמות נוצריים המתייחסים לחסד אלוהי וברכות. השם משקף את הרעיון של להיות מועדף ומבורך על ידי אלוהים.

in_greek.name: Μπενεδικτο
in_greek.meaning: Εὐλογητός, ὁ λαμβάνων εὐλογία παρὰ θεοῦ
in_greek.long_meaning: Τὸ ὄνομα Μπενεδικτο προέρχεται ἀπὸ τὸ λατινικὸ 'Benedictus', σηματοδοτώντας τὸ 'εὐλογητός'. Ἡ ἐτυμολογία τοῦ ονόματος συνδέεται μὲ τὴν χριστιανικὴ παράδοση, ὅπου ἡ εὐλογία ἀπὸ τὸ Θεὸ θεωρεῖται θεμελιώδες στοιχείο τῆς πνευματικῆς ζωῆς. Ὁ ἅγιος Βενεδίκτος ἀπὸ Νουρσία, ἕνας ἀπὸ τοὺς πιὸ σημαντικούς ἁγίους τῆς χριστιανικῆς οἰκουμένης, εἶναι ἕνα χαρακτηριστικὸ παράδειγμα.

in_latin.name: Benedicto
in_latin.meaning: Benedictus, qui benedictionem a Deo accipit
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Benedicto derivatur a latino 'Benedictus', quod significat 'benedictus'. Nomen hoc ad traditionem christianam pertinet, in qua benedictio a Deo accepta fundamentum vitae spiritualis habetur. Sanctus Benedictus de Nursia, qui unus ex sanctis christianorum eminentissimis est, huic nomini speciale testimonium praebet.

in_english.name: Benedicto
in_english.meaning: One who is blessed, receives blessing from God
in_english.long_meaning: The name Benedicto originates from the Latin 'Benedictus', meaning 'blessed'. It is deeply rooted in Christian tradition, symbolizing the receipt of divine blessing. The name reflects the idea of being favored and blessed by God, embodying spiritual richness and grace. Historically, Saint Benedict of Nursia, a pivotal figure in Christian monasticism, adds significant spiritual and cultural depth to the name.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Benedicto" is deeply rooted in Christian tradition and culture. It carries a sense of blessings and divine favor, reflecting the strong belief in the importance of seeking God's blessing in one's life. Naming a child Benedicto represents the hope that they will grow up to live in the favor of God and the blessing of the community.
data.spiritual_significance: For a Christian family, giving their child the name "Benedicto" imparts a deep spiritual significance. It serves as a constant reminder that the child is a precious gift from God and that God's blessing is essential for a life of goodness and happiness. It encourages the child to seek closeness with God and to strive to live a life pleasing to Him. The name Benedicto can inspire a sense of spiritual devotion and can instill in the child the importance of placing God at the center of their lives.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Benedict of Nursia (480-543 AD) was an Italian monk and the founder of the Benedictine Order. The name Benedicto carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Benedict of Nursia was a monk who founded the Benedictine Order in Italy during the 5th century.
